title: Royal Duke water and cooling attack-surface model
scope: Isolated defensive cyber-range simulation. No production endpoints or credentials.

fidelity.note: The S7 engineering surface models trust, asset context, and controller authority. It is not Siemens firmware and does not expose an S7 listener.

assets.label: Vendor access broker
assets.role: Creates an attributable, expiring maintenance session

assets.label: Engineering workstation
assets.role: Holds the controller project, station identity, and approved change path

assets.label: Operator / protocol gateway
assets.role: Polls Modbus process data, projects the operator view, and serves DNP3 points

assets.label: Water process PLC
assets.role: Runs pump, pressure, flow, alarm, and optional safety-interlock logic

assets.label: Cooling water process
assets.role: Converts pump state into pressure, flow, and low-pressure alarms

surfaces.requiredAuthority: approved maintenance identity and active session
controller project context, station trust, and program/write mode
gateway message-bus update mapped to an allowed coil or register
isolated supervisory-network access; control uses select-before-operate

actions.label: Establish vendor maintenance session
actions.effect: A valid remote session exists; it grants no controller authority by itself.

actions.label: Resolve the engineering path
actions.effect: The session can reach the engineering enclave through the approved broker path.

actions.label: Acquire controller project context
actions.effect: Station identity, controller family, project mapping, and permitted change operation are known.

actions.label: Freeze the operator pressure view
actions.effect: The gateway holds the displayed pressure at 62 PSI while independent process telemetry remains live.

actions.label: Change the pump command
actions.effect: An allowlisted gateway update crosses live Modbus TCP and de-energizes the simulated pump.
actions.evidence: gateway update, Modbus coil write, PLC state transition

actions.label: Observe low-pressure consequence
actions.effect: The model records a physical consequence only after simulated pressure crosses the alarm threshold.
actions.evidence: independent process pressure and alarm point

controls.validates: project read and controller change authority
approved tag, value, origin, and maintenance window
minimum-pressure invariant independent of operator view
